arguments.text: Dear Grace, I am assisting the tenant of unit-H with arranging the one approved attended inspection for the intermittent leak under the kitchen sink. The tenant has approved only the inspection, not any repairs. The tenant is home Saturday 2027-06-12 09:00-12:00, and the inspection fee must stay within 45 USD. Could you please provide your written authorization confirming (1) the inspection is authorized for an attended slot on 2027-06-12 within the tenant's window, (2) the inspection scope only, with no repair authorized, and (3) that the cost, within the 45 USD cap, will be covered by you as the landlord? Please also confirm if Metro Plumbing dispatch is your approved provider for this inspection. Thank you.
